TITLE: Vein Melter
DESCRIPTION: A dendritic dynamical system. Click to paint.

CONTROLS.NAME: pulse_out
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Sends a pulse outward from the center, leaving a dark hole in the middle of the screen after it passes.

CONTROLS.NAME: full_pulse
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Sends a pulse through all the veins on screen at once, changing and rotating their shape.

CONTROLS.NAME: retract
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: When on, pulls all the veins backwards, making it much more minimal/amorphous.

CONTROLS.NAME: devolve
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: When on, devolves into a sort of random chaos of ripples and bursts.

CONTROLS.NAME: heartbeat_intensity
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Heartbeat, or breathing, that oscillates in and out every other bar. This affects the intensity.

CONTROLS.NAME: color_palette
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Select from one of 5 color palettes. From bottom to top: Blood, Firey Orange/Blue, Green Forest, Blue Sky, Black/White.

CONTROLS.NAME: melt_up_or_down
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: 50% is default: no melting up or down. Move up to melt up and in, down to melt down and out.

CONTROLS.NAME: zooming
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: 50% is default no zooming. Move up to zoom in, down to zoom out.

CONTROLS.NAME: paint1_on
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: When ON, paint1 is enabled. Audio-reactive paintbrush that drips extra fluid onto the simulation.

CONTROLS.NAME: brush_size1
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Size & intensity of the effect for paint1.

CONTROLS.NAME: paint2_on
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: When ON, paint2 is enabled. Pulls around the simulation like a dipping your finger into liquid.

CONTROLS.NAME: paint2XY
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Mirrored painting, but also TWO KINDS of brushes in one XY pad. On left half of the pad = a wide brush. Right half = more simple circular brush.

CONTROLS.NAME: grab_frame
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Grabs a frame from the underlying media and resets the simulation based on the brightness.

CONTROLS.NAME: opacity
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: 100% is full opacity for the media effect, 0% is just the normal simulation, no media.

CONTROLS.NAME: refraction
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Affects how much the video is refracted by the simulation.

CONTROLS.NAME: combine_colors
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: When off, ignores the underlying 'color palette' and just uses the media. When on, multiplies the two.

CONTROLS.NAME: reset_sim
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Resets the simulation back to its initial state. The panic button when you don't like what is going on.
